curated.conceptDesc: Universal glowing USB protocol connector securely bridging AI reasoning agents to databases, file vaults, and browser robots.
curated.oneLiner: The open USB-C standard for AI — lets AI agents securely plug into databases, local files, and web tools.
curated.notes: Enables Antigravity and VidiFlow subagents to execute tools securely.

anatomy.desc: The LLM that decides which external tool to call.
Databases, local repositories, browser sessions, and APIs.
Open JSON-RPC 2.0 interface connecting agents to tools.

flow.title: Agent Needs Tool

flow.desc: JSON-RPC request sent via standardized protocol.
